messages.subject: Forecasting TVECM
messages.body_plain:
Dear Matthieu,

I am a Phd student interested in using tsDyn to model and forecast mortality cointegration among population using TVECM. I have made it to fitting VECM and TVECM, but wanted to do forecasting. I see that the package have "predict" function for VAR, VECM but not for TVECM. Can you help me to work this out?
Thanks a lot.

Haneef
